method: Unweighted OLS on cell medians: time_ms = intercept + slope * payload_GiB. No zero-hit points. Prediction only within observed payload range.
caveats: Descriptive shared-GPU fit; samples/cells may be time-correlated. No causal inference, no pure compute inference, no 64K/128K extrapolation. Negative intercepts indicate limited-range empirical behavior, not physical negative overhead.

prefill_service_fit.features: M=(L-H); causal_pairs=M*(2H+M+1)/2. Intercept plus M/1024, pairs/1e8, payload GiB, CPU-load indicator.
prefill_service_fit.interpretation: Empirical service-time regression including CPU loading. Coefficients are not measured GPU costs. Leave-one-length-out tests generalization, including boundary-length extrapolation within this native-context experiment. Never extrapolate to unsupported contexts.
